name: Set C: Enough.
angle: Frustration: the workarounds people do every day, then the wall between phone and PC breaks

captions.text:
Walked across the room
for a sign-in code.

lines.text: Walked across the room for a sign-in code.
Well, now you don't have to.
Copy on your phone. Paste on your PC.
Codes, texts, your whole phone, on your laptop.

music.prompt: Tense minimal electronic pulse with a ticking clock feel that builds frustration, then halfway through it opens into a wide, confident, uplifting cinematic synth swell, 100 bpm, no vocals

copy.primary: Emailing yourself links. Walking across the room for a code. Typing a link letter by letter. Enough.
copy.headline: Your phone, on your PC
